comment:
* Internal phonenumber matching API used to isolate the underlying implementation of the
 * matcher and allow different implementations to be swapped in easily.

methods.name: boolean matchNationalNumber(CharSequence number, PhoneNumberDesc numberDesc, boolean allowPrefixMatch)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the given national number (a string containing only decimal digits) matches
   * the national number pattern defined in the given {@code PhoneNumberDesc} message.

methodNames: boolean matchNationalNumber(CharSequence number, PhoneNumberDesc numberDesc, boolean allowPrefixMatch)
